currentTransformation.title: Transform the real autonomous climb into a legible, cinematic, responsive expedition
currentTransformation.state: BUILDING COHESIVE CLIMB AND ENCOUNTER SLICE — QUALITY NOT EVALUATED
currentTransformation.promise: One coherent climb: monumental original 3D environments, grounded grip-to-landing motion, tactical visible decisions, understandable guardian danger and opt-in terrain-aware spatial sound, with a minimal in-game HUD.
currentTransformation.nextDecision: Continue the same unverified climb-and-guardian transformation. Newly implemented: deterministic next-tick support-safe tactical evasion (historical-v1 unchanged), defensive skinned-hero posture, original one-authoritative-step cylindrical live projectile trails, and bounded opt-in defence audio with sample-capability fallback. Existing quality-contract CI had 10 failures; six WebAudio boundary and four old pinned-source fixture checks are addressed in code but new CI and visual evidence remain pending. Review genuine same-seed desktop and phone 68s ascent/danger/outcome+restart video, then five independent blind critics for LOOKS/FEELS/PLAYS and real-device frame-time tails. Remain NOT EVALUATED.
currentTransformation.rejectedMicroMilestones: A green CI run, an isolated pose fix, a prettier screenshot or an extra UI icon never counts as a Gauntlet win.
